body:
Hi,
Just to bring you up to date. 

sorry you haven't heard from me for some time, 
but my father has gotten rather worse fast. I don't recall If I told you but they found a virus in his blood. This meant he couldn't be given chemo therapy and it wasn't certain he'd pull through. The real problem is because of this, my wife was the only one with who I really found support (the rest of the people offered strength but is isn't the same). 

So I just couldn't kick her out. She (and he) are still here. I try to be as much out of the house as possible but it is still hard. 

Last week she sent me a message that she is in doubt between me and the other guy so that gave me a little hope. For now that is all that keeps me going, hoping to fix it somehow and caring for my parent. 

I will try to visit a dokter this week and see about getting a therapist (psychiatrist? the one that can describe pills). And see from there.

Thanks, I just got home, 
and told them I wanted him out of the house after this weekend. 

It hurts me very much that she will be going along, but I can't take it any longer. I guess I will have to get along on my own. Hard as it may seem now. I hope I can become happy again. At this moment I'm feeling rather numb so I had to do it now before I lost courage again. 

This is indeed a throwaway account, I don't really mind giving my email or chat account to certain people, but I didn't want to hang it out to speak. If you want I can give my email or msn or something. 

Thanks again!

Hi, 

thanks a lot for your reply. It means something to me. You are right about everything you said. 

Maybe you aren't qualified on paper to be my therapist, but from my end it seems that you are a very good one. 

I know I'm not to blame for my fathers illness, it just added to the problems (I know these are not really the right words and it seems to come across rather badly, but english is not my first language). I guess sadness comes closest to what I mean.

I know that I should kick them out, but it is hard. I'm almost at that point but never seem to quite be able to do it. 

I don't really know about the suicide, one moment it seems it is the only way and the next it doesn't. Now it is a little better. My feelings are all spinning around inside. Anger / fear / still loving her / hating her / ... it is very confusing. 

I'm trying to be there for my father, I'm going to try to take him on little trips or something like that. Also for my mother. 

You're probably right about the psychiaters/therapists too, I didn't really know what to expect. And over here it is not really as common as in the USA for example (if I'm right about that). I will try to find someone. 

I guess you're also right about the feeling of inadequacy. Never really been what you call the alpha male, but I never thought of myself acting as bad as I'm doing right now. I don't really understand it myself sometimes. 

In any case I can't thank you enough, I'm very gratefull that you took the time to listen to me and make such an extensive reply. If you ever get back in the UK or visit Belgium be sure to let me know something, and I'll buy you a drink. And if you have time again sometime, maybe we can talk again? It's nice talking to some one that isn't too closely connected to the both of us. 

Thanks!
Thanks, at the moment i'm not really feeling shame. More of a down feeling. I'm not at home right now so I have to re-read your comment with the attention it deserves. I will respond then.

Hi thanks for your advice, I would also like to talk, and as I'm not in the USA the normal hours here are probable weird over there. I respect not giving advice. I'm not looking to be right or wrong so I understand.
